'''''Pacho''''' was a group of [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] that were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. They were inside the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Adarga]]'' to pick up cargo containers carrying [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes that rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] was trying to [[Capture of Research|steal]].
